name: Integrity
body:
The ghoul’s touch opens grievous wounds on the subject’s body.

Requirement: Ghoul HD 15

Effect: The subject takes 15d6 points of slashing, piercing or bludgeoning damage (the ghoul’s choice). A successful Fortitude save halves the damage.

Improved Loss

The ghoul can reduce the damage dealt by 1d6 to inflict 2 points of bleed damage on the target, up to a maximum of 10 points of bleed damage by sacrificing 5d6 of damage. The Fortitude save can halve the rest of the damage, but does not reduce the bleed damage.

Gain and Loss

If the target fails its saving throw against this effect, the ghoul gains fast healing 5 for 10 minutes.
